questions.question: Which of the following is the largest planetarium of Asia?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Birla Planetarium, Kolkata.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** largest planetarium in Asia and the second largest planetarium** in the world, it is located in Central Kolkata between St. Paul's Cathedral and the** Maidan.**
 
• The **Birla Planetarium is a single-story circular **building with typical Indian architecture that is loosely modelled after the Buddhist Stupa at Sanchi. It is located in** Kolkata, West Bengal, India.**
 
• It features an** astronomy exhibit where a sizable collection **of exquisite paintings and celestial **models **made by illustrious astronomers are kept.
 
• An **astronomical observatory** with a Celestron C-14 telescope and extras like a ST6 CCD camera and sun filter is also available at the Planetarium.
 
• **Pandit Jawahar Lal Nehru, the country's then-prime minister,** opened the beautiful structure. The planetarium regularly hosts one-hour programmes in the three primary languages of Bengali, Hindi, and English about the wonders of the universe and facts **about galaxies** throughout the day. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On March 3rd, 1977, the **Nehru Planetarium was officially** opened with the purpose of promoting a scientific mindset through edutainment (that's right! entertainment and education). The planetarium has made learning about **astronomy enjoyable. **
 
• The** five planetariums in India that bear** Jawaharlal Nehru's name are referred to as Nehru Planetariums. Along with those in Mumbai, New Delhi, Pune, and Bangalore, there is also a Jawahar Planetarium in Prayagraj, the** birthplace of Jawaharlal Nehru.**
 
• In **Hyderabad, India, there is a scientific museum **called the B. M. Birla Science Museum. It was built by civil engineer P. A. Singaravelu and includes a dinosaurium, museum, science centre, and **art gallery.**

questions.question: Where is Havelock Island, a popular tourist destination located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Andaman and Nicobar Islands**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Havelock Island **is located east of the **Andaman Islands **and is administered by the **Nicobar Islands administration.**
 
• It was named for** British General Henry Havelock**, who lived in the area when India was a British colony.
 
• Govinda Nagar, Krishna Nagar, Radha Nagar, Shyam Nagar, and Bejoy Nagar are five prominent settlements on Havelock Island, each with its own beaches and lovely shorelines.
 
• According to reports, the island is home to the majority of the island's immigrant population from Myanmar and Bengal.
 
• As a memorial to Subhash Chandra Bose, the island was renamed Swaraj Dweep in 2018.
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose flew the national flag on the island in 1943, naming Andaman Island Shaheed Dweep and Nicobar Island Swaraj Dweep, before India's independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• At the confluence of the **Bay of Bengal and the Andaman Sea**, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are a union territory of India consisting of 572 islands, 37 of which are inhabited.
 
• The Andaman Sea separates the area from Thailand and Myanmar, around 150 kilometres north of Aceh, Indonesia.
 
• It is divided into two island groups, the Andaman Islands (partly) and the Nicobar Islands, by the 150-kilometre-long Ten Degree Channel, with the Andaman Islands to the north and the Nicobar Islands to the south.

questions.question: In which of the following states is Sri Bhramaramba Mallikarjuna Temple located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Sri Bhramaramba Mallikarjuna Temple or Srisailam Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to the deities Shiva and Parvati is located in **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• This temple is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva and one of the eighteen Shakti Peethas of goddess Parvati. 
 
• Shiva is worshipped as Mallikarjuna and is represented by the lingam. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The temple architecture in India is not the same everywhere.
 
• Basically, there are three styles of temple architecture in India:

 
• Nagara Style (North India)
 
• Dravida Style (South India)
 
• Vasara style (Mix of Nagara and Dravida style)

 
• Nagara Style:

 
• Built on a stone platform with steps leading up to it.
 
• Have a tower or Shikhara.
 
• Have Grabhagriha ( A place for the idols of god and goddess).
 
• Examples: Kandariya Mahadeo temple at Khajuraho, Lakshamana temple

 
• Dravida Style:

 
• Generally enclosed within a compounded wall.
 
• The entrance gateway is known as Gopuram.
 
• The shape of the Temple tower is known as Vimana (similar to Shikhara in Nagara style).
 
• Large water tanks are common in the temple complex.
 
• Examples: Brahadeeshwara temple, Rajarajeswara temple.

 
• Vasara style:

 
• This style of temple architecture is a mix of Nagara and Dravid styles.
 
• Examples: Dodda Basappa Temple, Hoysala Temple
